review_description: RK Solar were brilliant from the get go. They provided me with their quote straight away and were always prompt in replying to my many emails and the questions that I had.The battery I was considering getting was the Alpha ESS and RK Solar came up with the best price. Although the price was good, it wasn't my only consideration in going ahead with the purchase. I found the whole experience in dealing with them to be hassle free and painless. They were always professional and very knowledgeable.The installation was scheduled for December 5 and it went well. They turned up on the day and were on time. I was particularly pleased that they didn't have to run conduits along the external wall of the house to connect to my meter box as they managed to get under the house and run the cables through the wall cavity. It resulted in a much neater installation and saved me having to modify the post that supports my side gate. When the job was done they help me setup the Alpha app on my phone so I could monitor my solar system.However, the day after the installation I noticed there was an issue with the battery. The error light on the battery panel was on and the battery wasn't achieving full charge. It could only manage 10% charge no matter how sunny it was. I reported it RK Solar and they responded quickly and that they were investigating it. After a day I received another email from them stating that they have escalated the matter to Alpha and that they were awaitng a response. Alpha seemed to be dragging their feet in resolving the issue as it took them several days to respond. They eventually responded saying that they suspected the problem to be a communication issue with the battery.RK Solar contacted me to advise that they wanted to come over on Decmber 20 to fix the problem. Unfortunately, that date was not suitable as for us as I wanted to be present when they came. I asked them to reschedule it and the repair eventually took place on the January 15, hence this late review. I now have a fully functioning battery and solar system, very happy.I saw the electrician remove and replace an RJ45 connector from the battery so I guess Alpha was spot-on in their assessment that it was a communication problem.There was a hiccup in my battery installation process but overall the experience was positive.

review_description: Sales- polite and friendly, however not super knowledgeable, as he had only been in the job a few weeks. I'm sure that will improve.Install- It took 6 site visits over almost 3 months to finally install and commission the system correctly.Day 1- Array installers arrive- array is installed great work.Day 2- Electrician arrives (quite late in the day) discovers there is an issue with the wiring that I had had installed at my cost, and discussed with RK solar. Decides the cabling needs to be replaced, but only gets the battery installed on this day.Day 3- Electrician returns- replaces cabling (At their cost, thank you RK Solar) and installs/ commissions inverter. At end of day when "complete" I ask about the anti-islanding contactor for full backup- this I had discussed and confirmed at quote stage that it was included.  Further comms tried to suggest that it would cost another ~$900 to install full backup capability. After sending email evidence of confirmation that it was included, RK solar apologised and accepted to install at their cost. After commissioning I discovered the fronius smart meter had been configured incorrectly, and was as a result providing power readings double that of actual generation..Day 4- Fixed the smart meter issue, and Attempt 1 to install anti-islanding contactor. Installer had not purchased the correct relay, and thus was unable to complete despite spending most of the day on the phone with Fronius.Day 5- Attempt 2 to install anti islanding contactor.- Successful. After this day, I paid RK solar, before discovering an issue with the strings being wired the wrong way around on the inverter- meaning I was generating max 7.5kw from a 10kW system.Day 6- after weeks of trying to get the technician out to fix the string connection issue, they finally came- 5 minute job- change the strings over and now finally everything works as it should!Conclusion-RK Solar management is very clearly committed to ensuring their customers are happy, however there is obviously a disconnect between sales and  management- twice they tried to add variations, and both times I had email confirmation that the costs were included. Thanks to RK Solar for respecting this, and honouring the original quote.The electrician made at least 3 errors with the installation that required rectification. A less astute customer would not have noticed these issues, and so there was a risk that these issues/errors would lead to a poorly performing system, or a system that was not as per the agreed specification.The planning and during-install communications were woeful. On several occasions, I either stayed home from work expecting them to turn up after having been told they would turn up "tomorrow".. Or having to race home in the middle of the day to be there to meet the installer.  The electrician did not have good customer communication skills and treated me like I had no idea. It became clear that this was because the electrician was quite inexperienced with installing this kind of system.Overall, however, After 3 months and many phone calls and emails, I am very pleased with the solar and battery system that I chose. I think RK solar could improve by making sure technical staff are competent and have adequate training and by improving both internal and customer communication. Top marks for honouring the original quote.

R K Solar helped us all the way including the final step of organising the grid connection. Will highly recommend them to anyone including friends and family.
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: Sales quote was impressive. Salesperson showed me pictures of my roof across the seasons showing the extent of shading and designed my system size, configuration and placement accordingly.All aspects were on time as advised ans the team who installed were highly professional.cleaned up afterwards.After sales service was really good immediately resolved a tripping issue due to high voltage coming in from the streetOverall 11/10
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: We already had 2x5Kw solar arrays & a battery install,  this particular job was to add a Sonnen backup system & add an additional 4Kw (2 x 2Kw modules) to our Sonnen Battery.RK Solarâ€™s Installation was well planned & installation of the three phase Backup Box went smoothly, only issue was one of the Sonnen 2Kw battery Modules was faulty. RK solar chased Sonnen on the warranty replacement and the 2nd Battery was fitted a week later.The system hasnâ€™t skipped a beat and as I write our Power just went off for about 10 minutes & everything worked as planned, we had 10 minutes of backup power & then the system reverted back to the old poles & wires when the main power returned ????Love the system & I would recommend RK Solar as their pre sales, installation & after sales Service are fantastic !Happy client !
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: I'm very happy with this company and our solar package. Our installation was tricky: panels facing three directions, the roof has two tiers. RK Solar sent their own in-house installer to inspect and consult and we made sure the system was well designed and priced for our needs.
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: We got RK Solar to install some solar panels a few years ago. Recently we wanted to upgrade so we contacted them again. They increased the number of panels and also installed a 10Kwh Sonnen battery. In both cases the installation was done efficiently and we have not had any problems.
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: They had some trouble getting the wiring sorted out so the system reported properly. The issues came from the fact that another company installed the panels and system, and they installed the battery sustem.

review_description: I have used RK Solar twice to add additional solar panels and the modular Enphase Battery system. I found the company competitive on price and they kept me informed. The mutually agreeable times for installation were made and the team was always punctual. All packaging and debris was cleaned up and removed.
company_name: RK Solar And Consulting Services Pty Ltd

review_description: I have used Simmark twice so far in 2025 — to install a new Daikin AC system in May and a Sigenergy SigenStor 16kWh home battery in August.As always with this company, I was incredibly impressed with the efforts of its Southern Highlands based tech team.  Peter, Luke, Rob, Shane, Cam, Jack and Max (and several others whose names escape me!) were friendly, courteous, cooperative, easy to communicate with and extremely conscientious about getting every aspect of my battery installation 100% right from start to finish.The team went above and beyond the standards of professionalism I expect from qualified tradespeople and their level of customer service — from the initial visit/battery & new solar panel quote to completion of my system and walking me through the steps of how it was configured, powered and operates — was nothing short of excellent. They also took the time to patiently explain the safety features and how to properly switch the unit on and off which, of course, is critical information that needed to be clearly understood. They made feel comfortable that I could respond quickly and appropriately in case of a battery-related emergency which was greatly appreciated.Simmark did a fantastically consistent job of installing my SigenStor unit and will always be my first choice should I need to undertake any new home-based electrical projects in the future.

Sales/quoting process was very simple. Technician came to my house and walked me through the process including install, operation and functions.Installation was over 2 days. Very painless. Tidy, polite.Customer service was exceptional on all levels.

I still don't know if the installation is connected to the grid. As I had an existing small installation I was told that it was tohappen automatically. Not sure whether that is the case.The installation procedure was fine.The sales process was somehow shady. I asked for a contract and received something I definitely couldn't sign.After that I decided to do without and paid the advance to get started as we had already the approval from Aurora.

My dealings with Ross from the sales team were very positive. He provided a competitive quote in a timely way. Unfortunately the battery that we were quoted on ended up being unsuitable for our property, so we had to change plans at the time of installation.Another employee, gave me an installation date within a couple of weeks of paying the 10% deposit on 25 September 2023. This was meant to be 6 December, which was more than the 5 weeks indicated in the original proposal, Unfortunately I received a call in the afternoon of 5 December advising that installation would be delayed until 18 December 2023.The installers arrived on 18 December 2023 and discovered that the battery that we had been quoted on, was not suitable for our set-up. The team came up with an alternative, that cost more, and was not available until after the Christmas period.The battery was finally installed on 31 January 2024 however the necessary wiring work was not completed until 14 February. The ESV inspector attended on 26 February and has advised that more work needs to be done by the installer in order for our system to be connected to the grid.I am hoping that by mid March this work will be done, but I am still waiting for confirmation.

The sales/quoting was definitely a 5 star. Prajwal was very thorough in explaining the system to me and was also very helpful correcting what I might have misunerstood. He explained to me how the Tesla battery is better. He convinced me to go with Tesla for battery and it is really a good decision and I am really glad he convinced me to do so.The installation process is where things can be improved. I paid a deposit of 20 percent on September 21, 2023 a day after I signed up with Prajwal. It was not after over 2 weeks that I heard from the installation man, Harsh. I was getting worried and was starting to think that I got scammed. Harsh reassured me but was not able to give an exact date of installation just a rough estimate. I am not sure exactly of the time frames, but close to the date of the rough estimate of the installation, they informed me that the guy who is suppose to do my solar installation had an accident. He fell of the roof apparently. My installation was postponed without a definite installation date. I was worried that their company might close before my solar is installed. The most frustrating part is they give me non definite installation day, something they are hoping for but then they never call to confirm that it is gonna happen or even if it was not going to happen. I got cranky and unhappy during the waiting time for installation. I feel bad to those I might have been rude on the phone. The installation eventually was completed on the 5th of December, 2 and a half months since I paid the deposit. I paid the rest cash as I did not get the battery interest free loan being offered by Victoria.The installers were polite. They came on the day early. Ahmad appears to be well knowledgeable about what he is doing. I also find that he does not accept sub standards and wants things to be done to the best. They were also quite careful and only broke one roof tile which is really good as I only had 8 spares. They cleaned and tidied the garage really well.Sunrun organised the grid connection, but because it was the Holidays already, Powercor was on holidays too and did not get my solar alteration, whatever that means until 12/02/24. That is when I finally started getting Feed-in Tariffs.The process starting from when I signed up to having FIT took almost 5 months. Inspite of all, I am still happy to give a 5 star review. The guys just needs to communicate with their customers more frequently.Would I recommend Sunrun Solar? Absolutely Yes.

Sales person was very good to work with. Offered a number of options and didn’t try a bluff his way through the process. He was very honest and corrected some of my incorrect assumptions about the system we were considering.Installers were very punctual, polite and tidy. There were some minor things with the install that with hindsight could have been done differently but they were only minor cosmetic issues and not technical issues. All wiring and final connections were completed professionally.They withheld getting final payment until the job was fully completed as there was a wait for a week for specialist plugs to add panels to my existing system.Organised electrical inspection for connection to the grid.

Paul was very knowledgeable and explained everything thoroughly. He was friendly and returned my calls promptly. The installers were friendly, on time and left the premises in a clean and tidy manner. The only downside was the gutter was damaged lifting the panels onto the roof. The colour has been removed and I will have to organise with a painter to repair them. Talking to someone on the phone who I can understand is frustrating. I needed assistance setting up my app and it took forever as I had to keep asking them to repeat what they said. You can’t have someone trying to help you when you don’t understand them!

After dealing with highly professional people following the best practices I can surely say that my first experience of getting solar installed was 100% seamless and smooth. I got detailed information about each step and honest opinion about my every question. After getting quotes and researching various solar companies I trust that this totally one stands out with the value and service they provide. I have already started getting my bills credited every month and would highly recommend these people over any other solar company anytime!The team at Sunrun Solar are the best and are really helpful with their post installation services as well which is what to you need to look for.

My wife and I settled on a 7.4kw sytem. This comprised 20 x REC Alpha 370 Panels and a 6kw SolarEdge Inverter.The icing on the cake was the decision to also purchase the Tesla Powerwall 2.The People at Sunrun were easy to deal with and true to their word. No funny business with quotes and their recommendations matched the research I had undertaken.The panel/inverter install went well and the install team were polite and friendly. Importantly, they treated this old couple with respect and a mindset of helping out where they could. They even offered to trim some tree branches that would shade some panels in the winter months. James and his team were a pleasure to engage with.The site was cleaned up and swept clean and the final product - panels on two roofs, sub-switch board and inverter in the garage, all looked great and as if they were always there.James spent time with us at the end of the job, setting up the inverter with our WiFi and showing us how to use it.The Battery Installation was carried out by a different crew  a few weeks later. Same degree of service. Just nice people. They integrated the position of the battery with the Inverter so that the whole project looks neat and tidy.Meter reconfiguration for FIT and final inspections all went through seamlessly.Would I do business with these guys again? Most certainly. The price was about what we expected but the service was much better that what we expected.We found Sunrun Solar through Finn and his Team. Thanks for a great recommend.

Approx two and half years ago I was present at a house in Mount Waverley, Victoria whilst a representative from Sunrun Solar called Tarak Shah was present and  discussing/quoting a Solar installation package install for those premises.At the end of these discussions I requested a business card and booked a future inspection and quote for a Solar install on my own residential premises nearby.Mr Shah readily agreed to same and and appointment date and time was made there and then.NB: Property specs of the aforementioned proposed Solar Install1) 3 phase power utilised throughout the site2) Solar panels to be installed on the roof of a 2 storey shed3) 3 Phase Froniuos Inverter required4) Solar panels to be installed on the roof of a 2 storey shed currently under construction at the time situated at the rear of the premises.5) Fronius Inverter to be wall mounted in the above shed.6) Power from the inverter to the mains switch board to run under ground from the shed to the house, continuing underneath the house to the mains switchboard at the front of the house.Sales/Quoting Process:Mr Shah arrived exactly at the appointed time and day, made a site inspection, after which we discussed the above Solar Installation.He was extremely efficient and courteous with all my questions being answered plus unsolicited explanations and suggestions that I found very helpful.All of the above installation requirements were accommodated without any fuss what so ever.Using the internet, he then designed and made a sketch of what the installation would look like so that I could visualise it and discuss it with my wife later. The sketch also included the details of the solar panels to be used and the inverter.I contacted him the next day and requested a written quote which I received the same day. It was exactly as we had discussed the previous day and I made arrangements to visit Sunrun Solar premises to sign a contract and pay a deposit re same.Note: it took another 6 months before the roof was ready for the Solar installation.Installation day:Two installers (both electricians) arrived exactly at the appointed time and day and installed 20 solar panels, the inverter including all the wiring connected with same, by mid afternoon.They were very courteous, helpful and cleaned up and removed all the rubbish they generated during the install.Residual  Regulatory Requirements:i) A few days later an Electrical Inspector arrived and inspected the Solar Installation, and then activated it to the power grid.ii) Sunrun Solar then organised and submitted all the documentation required to register the installation with the relevant  electricity  service supplier, at the completion of which I received the installation and Inspection certificates, and other relative documents.I can only describe the above as a sensational experience with no 'hiccups'  of any kind.All planned phases of the install happened on time every time,  and I have no negative comments to make whatsoever.It was so good in fact that I have had Sunrun Solar install  a second Solar Panel  setup on the house, which was conducted exactly in the manner described above. No negative comments about this one either.Now! I was that impressed and satisfied with the above two installs, that I had Sunrun Solar supply and install a Tesla Battery approx 3 months ago.This to was carried out in the same efficient and effective manner of the previous two solar panel installs.In view of the above I have no hesitation in recommending Sunrun Solar as a Solar Power system installer, with Mr Shah as the go to man to discuss and organise your Solar Power requirements.

I could not be any happier with Darwin Solar and the system they have installed at my home.The process was made extremely easy, and the communication could not be faulted.David did a great job explaining how the system would benefit me, his communication thru out the process was excellent.Kellie in the office kept me updated at all times in regard to the application making it simple for me.The team who did the install turned up on time and explained everything as they went along and did a very tidy job.I highly recommend Darwin Solar to anyone considering solar.

I took 6 months to decide on a new solar / battery installation, getting quotes from a number of providers. Eventually i settled on Darwin Solar, based on the information the sales rep provided.Installation was quick and easySince the system has been installed, i have noticed an issue whereby the battery randomly charges from the grid. This mainly occurs on cloudy days. I have tried to get this resolved or find out why the battery charges from the grid for over two months, with only token responses from both Darwin Solar and Sungrow. They have no interest in providing a resolution or response.At the present time, consumer affairs have been engaged due the the lack of after sales service.I would not recommend to anyone these providers due to their lack of after sales service.

Quoting and design was super quick. James has recommended and quoted a few panel and battery options with explanation on the specs and what would work best for us.The installation was fast and efficient as well. Very happy with James and his team. Top service and great result delivered??

I paid $34,000 for a YOU BEAUTY SYSTEM that was going to save me all this money. I was and still am a invalid pensioner. The system was 39 solar panels on the roof which still leaks, 2 inverters which dont work and 1 large battery which has never even been connected. The installer walked away not even finishing it.Nobody would even come out to inspect the job from the company. Ive had electricians look at it and have no idea what they are looking at. They still contact me and taunt me about parts being on the way to fix it and the job was supposed to be done in Feb 2022. Nothing again. Im still waiting for it to be fixed and working but i know its not going to be done. Ive asked for my money back to no avail. Fair trading didnt help so they are hopeless as well. Im trying to find a barrister now or take civil action.Please do not be fooled by this company. They will  rip all your money off of you then rub it in your face for years after that.

The process was quick and efficient and they walked with me throughout the journey. I needed finance and they linked me to a company with low interest, no establishment fees or charges. The seller for me was knowing they are WA based and available, at request, for repairs and maintenance. I chose products with a 25 year warranty but for peace of mind the extra cost is worth it.

Daniel Shea Electrical was the quickest to respond, and the cheapest quote for the same products. Both Daniel and his installation staff were friendly and prompt with the installation.Daniel Shea Electrical handled all aspects of the installation including liaising with Ergon Energy for the grid connection.I would definitely recommend Daniel Shea Electrical to anyone that wants to install solar.
company_name: Daniel Shea Electrical and Solar Pty Ltd

review_description: â€¢How was the sales/quoting process?.On time, upfront, no pushiness friendly serviceâ€¢How did the installation go? On time, polite, good clean up after jobâ€¢How was the customer service? Customer service great, Ergon connection organised promptly and warranty  registered for us
company_name: Daniel Shea Electrical and Solar Pty Ltd

review_description: I received installer recommendations through solar quotes. I decided to go with Frazer Ekectrical. The owner Ben Frazer clearly explained my options, based on my present solar system and my larger monthly bills even with my 8kw Fronius inverter. I did pay more than I had originally budgeted but I now have 18.6Kw of panels on my roof along with a sigenergy 32.4kw battery and a 20kw inverter. Only had the install yesterday so time will tell. Too early to say what affect this will have but the service and quality of the install was great,

Quoting process was great and their price was much cheaper than others. Service and install was quick and seamless.Only one slight issue with booking the install dates where they changed dates and did not let me know. Luckily I had followed up with them to confirm which is when I found out. But once I spoke to them we were able to arrange a suitable day.Commissioning and explanation of the system was great.
Everything from start to finish was excellent. Workmanship fantastic and installed in one day.
Quotation and explanation  of the system itself was very good.  Installation went well in a day. System has been performing well. No post installation contact as yet, but is just gone 1 month.
Quote matched our requirements. No sales pressure quote,  explicit and honest answers to our questions

Ben visited before quoting, which I much appreciated.Installation was faster than expected, as I jumped into an unexpected opening in their calendar. The team arrived on time, and were all polite and tidy. I also had a minor follow up adjustment which was sorted without me needing to be home.Overall communications were great. The system was working by 3pm on the day of installation - all I had to do was call my provider and let them know I'd upgraded. Easy-peasy. The installer explained how it worked, and showed me the app.The Enphase app is terrific - I'm nerding out on the detail provided and annoying my family by talking too much about it! ? I'm looking forward to monitoring my future use and learning to make best use of the free power (ignoring system costs)
Good installation with just a minor delay. Helped organise grid connection.

Got my Enphase Batteries installed Dec 2024 and so far so good. Batteries seem to be operating as you would expect and look very neat and tidy on the wall of my garage. Frazer Electrical were terrific to deal with as I did ask for some additional work to be done, such as move my current Invertor and re-jig power and data points......just to make the whole package look a bit neater. Their pricing was concise and there were no surprise charges at the end of the job.

Was all done in a timely manner from the time I said let’s get some quotes from SolarQuotes  I was always in the know  throughout the process Frazer Electrical Group did an outstanding job throughout the whole process
Quote process was smooth and efficient. Installer provided good communication and follow-up support with a few minor teething issues - Support provided until the issues were resolved - great outcome!

The main reason I took so long to take up solar was because I did not know who to trust. Solar Quotes fixed that for me. This turned out to be one of the smoothest and most pleasant transactions I have done. Everybody from the salesperson to the office support to the installers and the inspector were right on the money and so supportive. And it didn't end there. Powershop have organised a new meter for us that allows us to feed into the grid. It was all so simple and seamless and now I am waiting for Energy Makeovers to complete the paperwork for me to claim the $2225.00 rebate from the Andrews Labor government. It all feels so immensely liberating.

From the start, each part of Apex Energy's dealings were first class. Their communication and quality of work was exceptional and all of their staff both talented and particular in all respects, We are delighted with the system.

From start to finish, Apex Energy were fantastic to deal with, very professional and excellent customer service. The solar system they recommended and installed works great. Confident to recommend them.

Colin Lord was my main contact in Apex Energy Australia for the installation of a battery.After I explained what I wanted and his visit, he thoroughly researched the options. The installation was somewhat complicated because I have solar panels on my house but also on the nearby shed and wanted them all to be connected to the battery. From this, he recommended a Tesla Powerwall.He organised that I got the government rebate and then arrived as promised with his colleagues to install the battery.It works great.I would not hesitate to recommend Apex Australia to my friends.Thank you Colin and Apex Energy Australia.Petra

Apex Energy provided me with a fantastic system and took me through the often complexed technical information so I understood how my investment would return savings whilst helping to reduce my carbon footprint. I have been recommending Apex Energy to my family & friends with confidence.

David and his team of installers provided a professional quote, kept me well informed during the approval and installation process and liaised directly with our power company to ensure a smooth transition.Thanks to the Apex team for helping me navigate the solar market and to find the best solution for my property.
Apex managed everything from start to finish and did a great job with minimum fuss. It was a large system quite some way from the house and year on everything has gone smoothly

I am in Balcatta Western Australia and I am extremely happy with the whole process of dealing with Kenny Solar, they were prompt to reply to all my enquiries, the price was great value. The installation is very neat and the installer was very knowledgeable and they cleaned up all their mess. I zero complaints against anything they did.Paul D.

Luke and the WA team at Kenny Solar made the entire process effortless. After comparing several quotes, I chose Kenny Solar for their competitive pricing and, more importantly, their friendly and approachable nature. They remained easily reachable even after the installation. I have received a Solis 10kW 3-phase system, which includes 16kW of panels and a 16kW/hr LG battery system. I'm looking forward to receiving the energy savings. Ben and the team who installed the system have been second to none with their installation and would highly recommend Luke and his team to supply and install a complete Solar system.

From start to finish, my experience with Kenny Solar was absolutely seamless. Robbie and his team made everything incredibly easy. Robbie was highly responsive, patiently answering all my questions and providing multiple quotes and options. Even when I requested changes a day before installation, he was accommodating and ensured that everything was tailored perfectly to my needs.The installation process was smooth and without any dramas. The team delivered high-quality workmanship and removed all the rubbish. The entire system was installed within just a few days, making the process swift and hassle-free.The end result is an amazing solar battery system that exceeds all my expectations and works flawlessly. I highly recommend reaching out to Robbie at Kenny Solar for anyone in need of a solar or battery system.

Initial consult with Rob @ Kenny Solar. He was responsive and worked with me to generate three quotes. Wasn't pushy, but was responsive to all questions. Rob's team were super efficient and professional. Grant answered all my questions and made sure everything was online and working properly. I even had a question the next day and Rob and Grant sorted it out. Grant even popped around to our house. The install looks great. I asked them to do a neat install inside the house and they did so, even though it would have been harder and taken more time. Grant helped to organise charging from the grid, and all works perfectly. Highly recommend the team at Kenny Solar.System is Goodwe three phase inverter, 7KW panels and 22KWh battery.
Sales / quoting was very good.Installation was excellent.Customer service pretty good.

Green link were upfront and honest that whilst their system might be slightly more expensive than others, they wanted to make sure they quoted on a safe and sustainable system that met required Vic safety standards and would meet our needs. I appreciated Cheryl and Graeme being thorough and for their follow through. Install crew were fantastic.

I've wanted a solar battery for some time but didn't know how to go about it, or what I needed to do to get the government rebate. I sent an enquiry to the Summit and Shore team on their website and they got it touch to get some more details about my usage and current solar panel set up. They also came to do a site visit and made sure I understood the process, understood where it would be installed and what I could expect post installation.With that information they created a proposal with two options outlined in detail, including projections of the cost savings over a 20 year period. It was incredibly helpful to see the options side by side and then also be called by one of the team who walked me through the pros and cons and helped me make a decision based on the features and price I was happy with. They also provided me with several financing options and answered my questions about the conditions and costs associated with these.The team reached out to me to set up an install day that suited me and confirmed beforehand. They arrived on time and worked efficiently to get the job done in good time. Even when there were some very tight corners in my house to run cabling through they made sure it was done properly, even installing an additional access point in my garage which wasn't initially part of the plan! When they left my garage and garden was cleaner than before they came!They checked in with me during the install, including giving me lots of notice for when the power would be off and getting it back on much quicker than I had expected. They showed me what had been done for the install, helped me to set up the app for tracking the power usage and generation on my phone and walked me through how to disconnect it in case of an emergency. They even provided remote oversight following the install to ensure the everything was working as it should.At all times throughout the process the whole team was professional, polite and clearly well informed. They patiently answered all my many questions and explained everything in terminology I could understand. They handled all the paperwork including applications, rebate and financing for me so it felt easy. The only paperwork I had to spend time on was actually applying for the finance, which is to be expected. Even then, they set it up so the rest of the process was sorted.I'm absolutely thrilled with my battery, it's incredibly satisfying to see how much energy I'm saving on my app. I'm even more thrilled at what great value it worked out to be with the team helping to get the best out of the government rebate and giving me an amazing value deal on top of that.I highly recommend Summit and Shore Energy, I would use them again without a moment's hesitation.

There’s a lot of cowboys in the solar installation rodeo, but there is also a lot of amateurs that get bucked off because they don’t have what it takes to make it…Not this crowd! What an amazing team, right from the sales team when I walked into the showroom, through to the final installation. A big thank you to Keith for his patience and explanations of various system’s costings, limitations and benefits etc. Also met several other team members that were friendly, warm, attentive and courteous.Have to mention the showroom, awesome to be able to see all the products without having to rely on just brochures and a website only, really adds to the experience.Communication was fantastic and the quality and patience of advice and answers (I had a lot of questions) were both comprehensive and informative, which was important with such an investment.It goes without saying, but they took care of ALL the applications and paperwork with the government rebate and Energex. A very simple process for myself.I ended up going with a Sigenergy 10kw inverter and a 40kw battery setup with extra panels on the roof to add to my existing panels.The quality of the install was also fantastic, not a scrap of dust or insulation left over, just an amazing new installation.They were actually able to bring my installation forward 8 days earlier due to a cancellation, even though the sun was well up in the morning sky, and hot, they still managed to get the install finished before I got home AND the battery was just under half full. First night of install with zero energy from the grid. Super happy about that.Installers were all friendly and professional which reflected in their workmanship. Great communication from Adam and Jacob with a few last minute changes for an upgraded switchboard and battery additions, very glad they are on the ball. They have done it ALL properly the first time and ultimately saved me time and money in the process. They also noticed a slight bit of sag in my old roof where the panels were going to be fitted and did an amazing job of still managing to make it look great.Had the honour of meeting the owner Lucio too, it’s no wonder the team are fantastic as he definitely leads by example. Even though obviously busy, he still made the time to thank me for the business and to share my positive feelings about his team, of which he’s openly proud of.I am looking forward to fully utilising my new Sigenergy system and already obsessed with the app and its functionality. Next stop, energy trading.Also looking forward to my first credit invoice from an energy company in 5 years, even with my existing solar.Thanks team, absolutely zero hesitation in using them for anything extra in the future and more than happy to recommend to future clients.Spinal Tap would be proud because your business went to 11 out of 10.

The ESC team and particularly Keith Butler who was our Solar and Battery Design Consultant were exceptionally efficient and Professional to deal with.After much discussion with Keith we decided to take full advantage of the Battery Rebate offer and managed to fit another 9 KW on our roof.We are exceptionally happy we chose the Energy Solution Centre. They offer a very personalised service and really make special efforts to do the installation well.

We recently had installed a12kw solar system with Aiko Neostar panels & Sigen Controler & Gateway with 3x 8kw (24kw) batteries from Energy Solution Centre Nerang.We got many quotes from other solar companies. But the problem we had was we had a complicated hip roof divided into 3 levels to work with... Which was seen as a big problem with most companies.But not for Keith Butler he was our go to guy... he was informative, pleasent & showed us everything on a huge wall mounted computer screen. Which brought up your house on screen & showed you what was possible to attain on your roof visually.The installation was completed in one day & the next day we we off grid... The system is amazing... No more power bills... & in credit with power company... Not bad for spring weather... Thanks Keith & Energy Solution Centre... You guys are great...

Great local team that provided all the information we needed when we needed it. Great communication from sales to install to follow up check ins. Our Sigenergy system is running beautifully and looks great too. Comforting to know we have local business we can easily reach out to for any future needs.

Energy Solution Centre have been excellent to deal with. Keith our salesman was very easy to talk to & provided easy to understand information about  solar & battery systems. He was very knowledgeable regarding our current system, the government rebate & what was needed to upgrade to battery storage. He also visited our home to check how the system was to be installedWe decided on the Sigen 32kw battery system & 10 extra panels.  Install was delayed for a  month due to the high demand on the wholesalers, Jacob the installation manager kept us in the loop.Installation went without any problems & the team  were very professional & knowledgeable. Keith called us that evening to make sure we are happy & popped in the next day to check all was ok.We couldn’t be happier & highly recommend Energy Solution Centre for their excellent customer service & pricing.

I recently had some additional PV solar panels and a SigenStor 32kWh battery installed by Energy Solution Centre.The team at ESC were very engaging (a significant difference from the other retailers I considered) and took the time to understand our requirements and explain the key factors that ultimately influenced our decision. I recommend a visit to the showroom. Particular thanks to Lucio, Sean and Jacob. Additionally, the installation team (led by Millar) were communicative, friendly, and efficient.SigenStor seems to be the outstanding option for a home battery, with superior design and features. I'm very happy with the hardware and the mySigen app. The battery is compact and looks good installed in the garage ready for future use as an electric vehicle charger.I have since switched my energy supplier to Amber which gives me access to wholesale energy prices (for buying and selling). This degree of positivity will seem a little unbelievable but as someone with whose usual instinct is to want to do everything myself (including wondering if I could buy all the components on eBay and convert my whole house to run on a 48v system) because I'm so used to disappointment when I trust someone else, this whole process was a breath of fresh air.I felt that the sales pitch came with a degree of urgency but didn't feel pushed or hoodwinked and in the end a couple of things were thrown in to seal the deal. The installation was above and beyond, with extra helping hands that had not been specified in the contract as we did away with the old gas oven and hot water, even down to a neatly-performed waterproofing that was not asked for but definitely appreciated.The post-installation followup was actually better than expected as well so if this all seems a little too good to be true, it's because I've just become so used to being let down that when I feel I got more than I expected I feel I have to give full marks.As general advice I would say if you can afford it, over-spec. it. We combined this process with an EV (MG ZSev, also pleasantly surprising and already used much more than we had intended) and suddenly the gas, bottle rental, electricity bills (as best I can tell from close monitoring of the Fronius software, the first bill hasn't arrived yet) and fuel bills have evaporated. We're so close to off-grid already in winter that I feel like I only have to tolerate being on-grid as long as I feel they have some convenience to offer me. We're also no longer hostage to the whims of the scoundrels (I'm being polite) who run OPEC. It feels good.

The installers did give me a call to try and help, but they didn't know why and told be to google it or youtube it. I then started getting emails from gi asking for finial payment, however i was initially told during the sales process final payment is due 3 days after install to ensure it was all working correctly. As the system still wasn't working as it should have been, and poor response from Gi, i was withholding the payment until it was resolved. To my surprise, they answered the phone, acknowledged i was an end user and after i explained what was going on helped me to resolve the issue after a bit of digging around. (turns out it wasn't configured properly, and needed to be unplugged and re plugged in).Disappointing i had to spend a few nights and afternoons trying to resolve it myself.I still havent heard back from it to confirm its working or not, or in regards to the mismatched brackets being corrected.My recommendation to my friends and family is now to take a gamble on the cheaper guys (which would have saved me about $4000, or the equivalent on 2 years electricity bills on this $18,000 system) as my other neighbors  have all had good experiences with the cheaper guys.

I wanted a reasonable sized system that would have us covered in the event of a power outage, of which we’d had many in the last couple of years, and wasn’t so concerned with the feed in tariff, because at 5.6c/kW, it’s not going to make much difference. We also wanted a changeover switch for the generator put in the board as extra backup for extended outages, to avoid having a spaghetti junction inside.   The only way to be covered for a power outage is to have a battery system, and after listening to a few other salesmen push medium sized systems with mid-range components, or cheap systems with cheap components and some with zero reviews, we decided to go with AEM after Matt assured me they could provide a safe, reliable system to suit our needs.Chief electrician Wish turned up with his crew on time, had great control and oversight of the work, and had the system up and running in less than 3 days. All rebate applications put through by the office, no issues.  Tested system a few times with power outage simulations, and it all seemed fine……until we had a real power outage.  The inverter refused to kick in and run off the battery as it was supposed to, so through Matt and Wish, did a complete check of the wiring etc., and there didn’t seem to be any reason for the fault.  Sure, it was frustrating, but I had every confidence that it would be sorted.  As the guys had figured, turns out it was the only dodgy inverter Matt had encountered with Redback equipment.  After waiting a couple of weeks for supply of a new replacement, Wish turned up and did the swap, and after several power outages since, we’ve been able to carry on pretty much as normal.Would definitely recommend AEM for whatever system you’re after.

Matt from AEM was great - friendly and technically very knowledgeable and willing to engage in discussion on the fine details of the system. He obviously takes great pride in getting the best outcome, and was also the best priced out of the quotes that I got. Easy decision in the end. I'm now running off close to 100% renewable energy (Redback battery/inverter system) since it was switched on in early December, and should pay itself back in <10 years. Couldn't be happier.

Matt from AEM came with little delay to  assist my recovery from losing software upgrade SD cards in the innards of the Redback hybrid inverter.  He very competently found the cards and completed the software upgrade seamlessly. I highly recommend Matt and AEM if you require any solar related work done.

The AEM team are very professional and the solar energy generation results have exceeded my expectations. We are now 98% energy efficient in the first week after it being switched on at the beginning of September with plenty of rainy and cloudy days, with 9.6kW of solar panels and a 14kWh redback battery and we’ve sold a lot of electricity to the grid as well. Amazing!

Sales went out of there way to provide various options. The installation was timely everyone was polite and tidy. They even cleaned up after themselves which was surprising compared to other trades. After service was also amazing.
I could not believe that between zoom meeting , emailed photos, pdfs and phone calls the whole process happened without a hitch! Imagine I didn’t see someone physically until day of instillation!

From Managing Director to the apprentice electrician - staff were friendly, knowledgeable and obliging. Nothing was too difficult. Work site was left immaculate.Also - absolutely love my Redback system.

From the quoting process to installation, Advanced Energy Management have been a pleasure to deal with. Mathew provided me with many quotes and was very helpful in answering all of my questions. After obtaining several other quotes from other installers, we settled on Advanced Energy Management due to their complete package and competitive pricing.Herman was prompt in organsing our installation date. We only had to wait a week to have our system installed. Again, fantastic service.We had Chandler and Jack come to do our install. The install took two days to complete, and the boys were very professional, polite, and punctual. They kept us up to date every step of the way.Advanced Energy Management had even coordinated the compulsory final inspection of the system on the same day as the install date so we could be exporting electricity as soon as the installation was complete. Usually this process can take up to a couple of weeks!Kelly and Charlene from the office were also extremely helpful in settling our account.The system so far seems to be performing as described, and we are off the grid for the majority of the day.I have absolutely no hesitations in recommending AEM for your solar install!

Went onto SolarQuotes and got recommended 3 installers. 1 never returned my call, 1 spoke to me 1 day and never heard back from them, and the other sent me a way overpriced quote, plus never followed up. So, a mate had recently used Advanced Energy Management (AEM) for his solar install in Moonee Ponds (Melb) and was highly complimentary about them from quote to install. (and this mate is a real fussy guy).So, I rang AEM and spoke to Matt Delaney. Led by Chandler the main sparkie, the panel team went to work and completed the rooftop panels install on the 1st day. Chandler looked after the battery/inverter install.At the end of the 2nd day, all up and running. The inspector was booked that arvo, he arrived and clambered all over my roof checking everything. Signed off that day, advising me that AEM are great installs for him as they are so professional.Chandler and his team left a clean site, and a fully working system. Many thanks to Chandler and his install team.Matt Delaney even turned up to check up if I was happy, later that same day.All connections were professionally arranged by the AEM admin team, and 2 weeks later we were exporting back to the grid, and getting paid for it.I Highly Recommend AEMNote: you MUST get your electricity data from your provider (not retailer). The last 2 years data showed that only 27% of our electricity bill was used in Sunshine hours (or 63% was used when it's dark). This data showed we definitely needed a battery.

My first contact with AEM was via a phone call with Mathew, he was able to answer all my questions and offered to come view my property to give the most accurate evaluation of the type of solar system best suited. He is extremely well versed in all things solar and got back to me promptly with a quote. A few weeks later his work crew arrived on time and installed the system in a day. The project manager tested the machine, set up the wifi and took me through the basic operation of the inverter. I would be most confident in referring AEM to anybody in the future.Thanks Mathew for a seamless transaction and install. Greatly appreciated.

Installation of Solar system was done without any problems. Had a problem with system a few weeks of installation where it started to trip out, rang Esolar and within a few days the problem was solved and I have no problems since. review_description: From the start of our solar journey we found the team at E-Solar to be knowledgeable, supportive and understanding of our individual requirements. Nothing was too hard and the advice was so suitable to our situation. Installation was smooth and follow up detailed and supportive. Recommend this company very highly to anyone looking to installing a solar system.

I often experience outages in my area lasting only a couple of hours or so. Following a lightning strike recently, power from the grid was lost for over three days.The system installed by E Solar kicked in immediately. I was running two chest freezers, one fridge freezer combo and big screen TV with satellite system which draws a bit of power constantly looking for a signal.Consumption from the battery was around 25% overnight which left plenty in store for the following day. As soon as the sun came up, the battery recharged to full capacity.Customer service is outstanding from Silvio and Christy and their team of installers.Since having the system installed, I have never been inconvenienced whatsoever during outages. It's the best thing I've ever done and I highly recommend E Solar.

Christy was fantastic when I spoke to her about our needs and were very competitive in price and product. She helped us with the right configuration to suit our lifestyle and power consumption. We opted for 2 batteries and so far, have done what we wanted them to do. Everybody has been great and easy going at E-solar and worked around us. Great family business. My in-laws used E-Solar and I am glad we did the same.

I had E-Solar install a 7.4Kw solar system with 6.5Kw battery storage, system is blackout ready. If you want to get a super solar system I totally recommend E-Solar 22 Canham Way, Greenwood WA 6024. Great service, great product and a very friendly team.Thanks Christy and Silvio a job very well done.  Stewart

The eSolar Company in Canham Way Greenwood Perth have been really good to deal with. Always pleasant and helpful, providing us with quotes with no delay. Organising times for installation and answering phone queries ... they made sure everything went very smoothly.The installers were really efficient, polite and friendly and quiet where possible. The sales/quoting was extremely helpful in understanding the required system for my property.Quote was provided with 24 hours with an outline of 3 options and applicable prices.Silvio provided further information and was extremely helpful before making a final decision.Very impressed, I liaised with Ben (installer) several times as the agreed install date had to be changed due to poor weather. Signed up on the Thursday and installed following Wednesday. Had been thinking about getting solar but so many different companies out there.  Referred by a friend! eSolar were local, over 30 years experience and were not pushy! From Christy in the office to Tom and his team doing the installation, all very efficient, competitive pricing, professional and very friendly. I would highly recommend eSolar and being local, just a phone call away for service and queries.

Tindo has provided excellent customer service. They have kept us informed about where everything is up to. The salesperson was thorough and detailed in his advice to us and provided all the information we wanted during the quoting process. He’s also been easily available afterwards to respond to our queries. Installation was great, and the panels and inverter are working as expected so far. (We’ve only had them for 1 week.)  The installers were punctual, neat, polite and thorough in the installation and set up of the system, and in their explanations and responses to our questions. They did a great job. We haven’t yet had the ordered battery installed because there is a backlog. Hopefully that will happen soon. We’ve been impressed and happy with the process and products so far. While the price was a bit higher than other quotes, we were willing to pay it because of the quality of the system and the locally made solar panels.

We found the whole process quite smooth. The first contact was with a sales engineer who understood the system and was able to answer the slightly technical questions.Several other companies used call centres, obviously overseas, who only wanted to arrange on-site inspections. That may be fine, but in my opinion those types of installers favour slight sales pressure over a quality discussion.Kevin at Tindo Solar engaged in a good discussion of our needs and circumstances, provided options and answered our concerns.We feel very comfortable we have made the right choice.

Sales quoting process was impeccable.Lionel is a credit to the Tindo business.He answered all of our questions (and I bugged him for weeks with additional questions), educated us on a few points, and let us in on an unadvertised CommBank GreenLoan deal which gave us the ability to go bigger without breaking the budget.Install was floorless.  All trades did their jobs well and cleaned up so you wouldn’t have even known they were there.All panels, hardware and a Telsa car Charger all installed, configured and demo’d by lunchtime.They did EVERYTHING for us.You definitely get what you pay for!The SolarEdge monitoring app has been monitored and helped us change our usage habits to the point were we’re now using over 70% of our power from solar, and exporting a pile back to the grid.It’ll be time for a SolarEdge battery as soon as the budget allows to harness this excess.The Tindo panels are great and always buy Aussie made first if you can.
Every aspect of dealing with Tindo was first class in my obviously one off experience.

Right from the get go Tindo presented options for my needs with a friendly open and professional manner. Tindo stuffed me around when I installed my first 10kw system but now I want to put another 10kw on the house they took the order and I organised a first week in September install and was told all would be good but they just left it and I’ve called them twice now to be told they can’t get the parts so they didn’t call to update me they just left it so I have cancelled and I’ll go elsewhere very poor service…customer service very poor.

We purchased the home we had been renting for 4 years. As soon as we settled we contacted Tindo Solar as they are in Adelaide. From the first moment we dealt with them They were excellent. We went sure until we toured their factory (recommend you all do it). From the time we signed the purchase agreement we knew what was happening and when.  The only thing different was the installers were 2 days early.The installers were fantastic to deal with. Polite friendly and answered any questions we had. We did have a couple of issues but those were Origin Energy's faults. The team at Tindo helped us work through those and even after have been keen to advice when needed. We purchased a battery as well which has been great. Comes with an app so you can see what the battery and system are doing.

We have an existing 12 panel array (Sharp panels) making up 2.2kW with a Fronius IG20 inverter rated at 1.8kW.We wanted to expand our setup and potentially add a battery, with a view of moving to an electric vehicle in the next 12-18 months. We have recently changed our water heater over to a Sanden heat pump (was on-demand gas) so now we are a fully electric-only house.Tindo offered the following upgrade:22 x Tindo Karra-330 DC Solaredge Optimised Solar Panel1 x SolarEdge Storedge SE5000-AUS Grid Connect Inverter12-year Inverter and 25-year Solar Panel Warranties1 x LG Chem RESU 10HV Battery1 x Solaredge Electricity Meter Kit 1PH MonitorTiled Roof Array FrameSystem Power 7.26 kWNumber of Modules 22Number of Inverters 1Number of Phases 1The sales and quoting process was pretty straight-forward, The Tindo sales rep was switched on to what we were wanting, and the system offered looked like it would suit our current and future needs. The Solaredge inverter can have an integrated EV charging cable added in future if we need. This is a neat solution.The installation went well, the guys were in threat of being rained out, but the weather held off to complete most of the work. We still need to have a supply cut-off switch and a new meter put in place. We have some asbestos in our old meter box which is holding up the works, this needs to be removed (SAPN work?) before the final work can be done.Other than that, we have our battery working in the evenings and plenty of extra electricity being generated by the new system. The detailed monitoring has not been set up yet, but from our own observations of the import/export meter and the inverter/battery status, we are pretty well self-sufficient on solar, with plenty going back into the grid in the middle of the day.

Tindo is a South Australian company that we chose to support for its solar panels that are made right here in Adelaide- designed purposely for Australian conditions. They provide excellent service to boot, and we had no hesitation after 12 months to get a battery installed as well
Everything was smooth and without issue. The system was installed and running in one day. Sales rep didn't try to oversell us as some others did and listened to what we wanted whilst giving advice.

I found the sales and quoting process upfront and ran very smoothly.The installation ran smoothly. Everyone of the installers were polite, tidy and punctual.Customer service was excellent and very helpful through the whole process.
Customer service was excellent and the change of meter/grid connection went to plan

The quoting process was fabulous. Salesperson proposed and explained the system in detail. Was absolutely pleased with the proposed system though not cheap. Wished the Solaredge inverter proposed and installed was a HD series one instead of the older SE series. Installation went well but they left a cut wire sticking out on the roof and caused a leak when rain came. Called customer service about it and problem was quickly attended to, though there is a water mark on the roof.Happy system is live now, and generating energy and saving me money. System quote and installation was done very quickly - 18 days from quote to job completion. I had Sean from Supergreen solutions explain the process of changing over to a Tesla Powerwall 3 from Sungrow inverters, and he was very knowledgeable and informative. Attended SAE information invitation held at Twin Towns resort and satisfied to go ahead with the installation of Neovolt storage battery when given all related information. After many quotes I chose SAE.  The sales representative was super low pressure and able to answer all my questions in an objective way. Extremely happy with the solar system from Liteforce. We previously had some door to door salesman give us a price which was way off the mark. We were then referred to  Liteforce solar from a friend. Rory was a pleasure to deal with. He and his team do the work personally, unlike many other firms that sub contract the work out. Rory identified a number of issues while doing the quote that we could sort out before deciding on the final system to be installed. This meant we could not have one single phase string inverter but needed two equal string inverters, substantially increasing the cost. In the end we chose micro inverters on each panel which were a similar price to two single phase inverter and come with other advantages. As we are on a rural property it is some distance to the meter box and Rory had to do the calculations to determine if the existing cables were sufficient, luckily they were. Rory presented a number of options and quotes to which I made a number of changes until I settled on the final option. Rory happily worked through each of these quotes and options with me. In the end Roryâ€™s quote was comparable to the others but came with much greater certainty to other firms who took the approach that I would have to pay more if the subcontractors encounter issues once they arrived to do the job. Rory was always punctual and tidy, he handled all of the connection and rebate issue.  I am more than happy to recommend Rory and Lightforce.

Macdonald air and electrical recently installed our 11.1kw solar system with almost 8kw battery.The service was excellent from start to finish, and the installation went smoothly. Would recommend to anyone.   Looking forward to our offgrid lifestyle.

Alex MacDonald offered a competitive price for a system to run our house off grid. As stated above went above and beyond to ensure a seamless priceless

As a return customer, with 60 panels and 3 batteries, the site visits and quoting process is always prompt and market priced and value for money.  We have recommended Carbo Solar to many family members, friends, work colleagues who have ordered and had soar systems installed.The installations are always undertaken on the mutual scheduled timeline.  The installers are always punctual and tidy whilst installing the batteries, inverters and solar panels.The customer service is exceptional throughout the whole installation process and assisting with organising the grid connection with the service provider.

The Solar Flow quote was the most expensive, but no corners were cut. Right from the get go the professional guidance from evaluating our needs, from quoting the system without pressure or bias and the most careful, tidy installation one could wish for.

Solarpro helpful & professional. Not pushy. Well informed. Answered all questions, even stupid ones. Communicated well. Installers also very professional - on time, no fuss.Still waiting on my Electricity provider to contact me re net meter.

Excellent salesman, Harrison. Explained very clearly. Installer Justin was careful, efficient, consultative, tidy, supervised his apprentices well and explained clearly when there was a holdup. They installed our initial system 2 years ago,(16 panels with a battery ) and we have just added another 16 panels in 2021.
Solarpro were very professional - and we love our new system.
Good advice, responsive, quality installation, a good company to work with.

I approached the three suggested installers.One didn't come out, provided a quote which seemed reasonable, no opportunity to discuss my needs, didn't reply to my email asking further questions.Another did come out to quote and discuss. The salesperson decided to quote for a very large system which would have meant that we were selling a large proportion of what we would be producing back into the grid. He didn't consider that we had 3-phase nor the distance we were from the service lines.-SolaPro - salesperson was knowledgeable, took his time to properly understand our situation and suggest what would be best for us. He gave us a range to chose from for panels, inverter, battery and went through the pros and cons of each. We ended up adding a battery which was not our initial position but now believe it will provide a better system. Our decision was based on quality products and installer, not on price.

See above. Several visits to site by two different people were necessary to resolve both the possible location for battery and inverter, and to get power between the roof, three stories above, into the garage. A third party was engaged to drill holes through two balconies into the garage. Solution works well. Restoration satisfactory. Electrician in charge did very good job.We were lucky enough to (unexpectedly) buy a new house, but no provision had been made by the developer for the potential installation of solar power.Also I'd like to say how unhappy i am with government energy, GHG, and climate change policies.

SolarPro provided a thorough consultation and quotation, and listened and responded to our needs. They explained clearly where explanation was required. Emails were professional and timely. The company accommodated my last minute requests without a problem. The installation team was efficient and did a great job. We are mesmerised by the apps showing the ‘free’ power flowing! Looking forward to finding the right energy retailer.
Job was completed in budget and on time. Salesperson easy to talk with and explained in clear terms.Site was clean and tidy when work done.

Daniel the sales rep was incredibly helpful and honest, letting us know about the solar battery rebate that had been announced when we did not know about it. Decided to go ahead with the installation regardless and are super happy with it so far.The only hiccup that occured during the whole process was that the installation date didn't get communicated to us untill the day before when the Installation team leader called. He was incredibly apologetic and explained I should have received an email 2 weeks prior. It was his belief that due to the chaos caused by the battery rebate being announced prior to the state election with a commencement date after the election many people were cancelling or putting their orders on hold and the administration staff were swamped.Installers were incredibly helpful and friendly, one of the guys even offered to buy us a beer at the local pub when we ran into them there. After the install was complete on day 2 the installer ran through the system tests with me to show us how the system would work when back up power came online, showed me where all the breakers, isolators and conponents were located and what I would need to show any electricians in future. He also helped me set up the app, get it connected to the system and ran me through it.We are very happy with the Sigen System with 5kw inverter, 8kwh battery and 10kw of panels producing more than enough power to run the house during the day and most of the night depending on what we are using. The MySigen app is very user friendly with easy to understand insights into our power usage. Combined with ease of adjusting settings and the modularity of the system has been very helpful with getting the most out of it.
As I said before, the sales/quoting process went well. As you know this is a difficult time of year for the construction but all is moving forward.

review_description: The sales/quoting service was excellent, with easy one-on-one interactions (phone or SMS) with the sales person, who ultimately provided 4 or 5 different variations.Their were a couple of minor hiccups with the installation, mainly resulting from their office scheduling system that led to last minute adjustments of the timing. However, the field staff were outstanding, polite, efficient conscientious at completing the installation etc. It turned out that the Sigenergy system was relatively new to them, resulting in a couple of teething problems to establish communication, but the staff returned the following day to complete. Overall layout (slight adjustments made on site, after discussion with us) and neatness of the installation were top rate.Customer service has also been very good, once you know which section (or staff) within the company to contact. Most of the explanations on use of the system came from the lead installer, but he communicated very well. We have yet to use the EV charger (awaiting changing our car), but no reason to expect any problems.

First, please read through to see the final resolution of my issues. I bought 23 Hyundai 400W panels, with Enphase 7A inverters, and a Tesla Powerwall 2 with backup gateway. This replaced a very early system with 110W panels, 2.2kW maximum. The panels have been performing brilliantly, and I also signed up to Amber Electricity's Amber for Batteries program. I've been in credit every day except one since the install was finally commissioned.The problem is that I feel the installation process was not what I was expecting. I wanted a premium install - I'm an engineer myself and knowing it was anything less would prey on my mind. The installers were .. ok, at best.First, the quote was purely based on the salesman's visit, and that was what they planned to do the install based from, with no actual technical inspection or planning, which surprised me. I sent a number of emails, including concerns about possible mounting positions for the battery, after which they sent a technician to inspect the site. I asked that he properly measure the roof, from which we got an extra 4 panels up there. Those 4 panels have proved to be the difference between an export excess in winter and "just barely enough" for the house.When they turned up for the install, they were not prepared. They did not have the correct tools to dismantle the old system, and ended up using angle grinders to rip everything apart., There was no way they had planned enough labour, and ended up finishing in the dark. When the electrician left, one circuit wasn't working in the house, and I managed to grab him and he tightened up a connection and left. They had to finish in the dark as they had another install the next day to go to, so they couldn't just come back tomorrow or in a couple of days to finish up. Even so the system couldn't be commissioned (it was dark, which makes it hard to test the solar), so the electrician came back late the next day to commission it.Over the next few days I had issues with weird things in various places (like lights dimming when I turned a heater on). I didn't have faith in the solar company fixing it (in fairness, I didn't give them the opportunity and I didn't call them). I called my usual electrician and he came out and attached a number of wires in the switchboard that were loose o barely connected at all.I'm guessing that; and the fact that my roof has bits of wire insulation, electrical tape and other stuff all over it is because it is also very hard to clean up in the dark. I disassembled all the old system framing myself. I couldn't believe it when they told me they were going to take it all to the tip. Again, the quote did NOT say they would recycle it, but I couldn't bear to see all that solid aluminium dumped in a tip. I took it to a scrap metal dealer myself. The panels have no resale value, they're 110W and I'm nobody wants those now, but again, there is a lot of aluminium in there that's easily removed and recycled. I'm doing what I can to find a recycler for the panels themselves.In short, the installation works, and the products are very good, I just did not feel I got value for money from the installation. It might be that I'm too fussy, certainly other people seems to have been very happy with their work.UPDATE: the company came back after a few weeks and corrected some of the issues, with no arguments about my complaints. On that basis I have improved my score. First, they removed a cable that had been run under the ceiling joists in the garage (so I couldn’t put a new ceiling up). They also straightened out the wonky panel array, and they corrected the installation issue where the battery wasn’t charging from solar when the grid was out. All of these issues shouldn’t have happened, and I stand by my criticism of the initial install. All of that was, in my opinion, due to under-resourcing the install and being under too much pressure to get the install done in one day so they could move on. However, it’s to their credit that they came back without arguing about things and just fixed what I asked them to.
