The sales quoting process was great. The sales person spent a lot of time modifying my system as I compared systems from other installers and increased my understanding of my options.I had to hold off on going ahead with it as we were waiting to move back into our home that we had been renting out and initially our builder (renovations) wanted us to hold off until after work had been completed. Eventually we decided to go ahead and organised our finances with the bank. By the time we had decided to accept it there had been some cost increases. I believe the sales consultant when he actively worked to reduce the impact to the cost on us.The only part that upset me was regarding an application to increase the inverted capacity above 10kW with Ausgrid being the grid operator. The system was using microinverters and originally had an inverter capacity of 11.5kW. The sales consultant said that we could apply to exceed the 10kW at a cost of $750. I asked about why it cost so much, and I was told by the sales consultant that it was because the operator had to send someone out to do a manual site inspection where a local transformer was checked to see if it could handle additional capacity. I was told that they would tell us exactly what we would be able to have inverted so that we may even be able to expand later on.Eventually the design engineer came back and told us that the grid operator did not approve the additional capacity. I asked for correspondence between SEA and the grid operator, and it was clear that no real assessment was done. Ausgrid simply said that SEA needed to show how the system would be 10kW or less of inverter capacity, that 11.5 was greater than 10. I queried it with the design engineer, cc'ing the sales consultant and he said it was a technical assessment not a physical one, that the operator checks their transmission systems according to their network. But this is simply not true, Ausgrid wrote to SEA:"Single phase connections must have a maximum inverter capacity of 10kVA. Your application indicates 11.52kVA. Can you review and advise how the inverter capacity will be reduced to <10KVA. Note – export limiting while required for the battery and solar combination does not negate the maximum 10kVA PV IES requirement".So essentially, $750 was paid for the operator to check if 11.5 was larger than 10. It also delayed installation time by over a month whilst we waited on the results of the assessment. The sales consultant was cc'd in all these emails and never replied. The design engineer stopped replying to the issue.In the end I went forward with it as I was happy with the system and other reviews I had read on Solar Quotes. The sales consultant had originally put in a lot of time on the quote and sales process, just left me down after acceptance during this issue.Once the system size was reduced, the installation was scheduled very quickly, I think the next week. 4 men came out to install the solar panels, tesla battery and associated equipment. At the end of the day the solar was installed but they could not get the battery online. Another technician from SEA came 2 days later (offered to come the next morning but I was unavailable) and got the battery online. They were polite, professional, punctual, and everything was cleaned up on completion.It took a few weeks to get the system registered on the national database so I could sign up for a feed in agreement with my energy provided, but not sure where the delay came from here, not necessarily on SEA end. Customer service was pretty good whilst going back and forth regarding completion of installation paperwork and database registration.So far, the system has been and running for about a month. I can monitor the panels themselves with the enphase app and the battery in the tesla app. Everything appears to be running very well.From a technical needs aspect, I am very happy with the enphase with micro inverters and the whole house backup of the single phase with the tesla battery.Overall, I am very happy with the system. I feel like I got a good/reasonable price and was not ripped off. The quoting process/sales consultation and installation was good. Just a little disappointed with what seems to be a misunderstanding of the limitations of a single-phase installation and any means of applying to exceed these on the behalf of the sales consultant, the design engineer or both; as well as how it was handled. Even now, I am not sure if I have any ability in the future to expand my system except maybe with an additional battery. Hopefully as the grid is re-worked for more solar, these limitations are changed.I would recommend SEA, I would certainly speak to them again if I do want another battery and for my parents when they look to get a battery, increase the solar. I would also recommend using solar quotes to initiate the whole process and as a source of information when researching.

The SEA sales agent, Rob, was fantastic. Really knowledgeable and not pushy at all, a pleasure to deal with. After considering several other companies, and several system options from SEA, I was happy to go ahead and put a deposit down.The installation process was extremely smooth by Sam and his team, and the panels and inverter were installed and functional within a single day. The battery commissioning had to wait another 3 days due to staff shortages but came online with no issues. Initial problems with the EV charging rate and maintaining a connection to the SolarEdge app were resolved by two site visits from Dave, and therefore I am confident to say that the technical support by SEA is first rate. If you have any issues with your system they will come out to resolve as soon as possible, which may even be the same day.Unfortunately I had to wait close to three months after paying a deposit to have the system installed. I think this was due to SEA being in high demand towards the end of the year, as well as the Christmas shutdown and COVID disruptions. Which are all completely reasonable explanations, and although I had other companies that claimed to be able to do the installation within a week, I remain pleased I waited for SEA. Another minor negative was that I had to chase the finance office to process a refund for an inverter cover which wasn't required and the $250 SEA ambassador voucher, however this was no big deal as everything was resolved within 3 weeks after installation. All the paperwork to have the net energy meter activated was also sorted out fairly quickly by SEA. Overall I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending SEA to anyone looking to install solar.In terms of the system, I'm am extremely happy with the system and its performance after the first month of use. The 16 north-facing QCells Maxx-G3 390w panels are performing very well (I wish we could fit more!). The 5Kw SolarEdge inverter and monitoring app are also fantastic, and the system has produced a daily average of 25kWh in a very wet February. I am very pleased with the ability to charge the EV using solar only, or at a maximum rate of 7kW using battery/grid support boost option.The 5.04kWh Alpha ESS B3-Smile battery has performed well so far and has resulted in 89% self-sufficiency. We are adding another 5.04kWh module to ensure this is closer to 100% for the nights we run the A/C. The Alpha monitoring app is basic but functional. The monitoring dropped out but after re-configuring the WiFi settings is was re-instated and is now stable. We have also joined a VPP and are now receiving a very favourable feed in tariff, which will likely result in our electricity bill being reduced from $400/qt to an estimated $100 credit.In summary, I highly recommend SEA, they have provided a quality installation at a fair price, and their after sales support for the system has been great. I am confident they will honour the 10-year workmanship guarantee and 5-year whole-of-system warranty on the system.

Note - This is a review of our solar system installed by MPV in May 2017. I am providing this review now (Feb 2020) as I have been very impressed with the overall performance of the system over the past 34 months. MPV have also provided excellent support when there was a minor issue in December 2018 (see below).The quoting process was very thorough. MPV were the only company (of four who quoted) to insist on a site inspection before completing their quote.Matt (one of the company Directors) conducted the site visit and recommended a 5.12kW system comprising 16 x LG NEON-2 320W solar panels and a Solaredge SE-5000 inverter with Solaredge DC Optimisers installed on each solar panel. This would reduce the effect of partial shading, from a large tree in our backyard, on the system output. The DC Optimisers have the added advantage of providing individual panel monitoring. Eight panels were installed on the Northeast roof and eight on the Northwest roof. This allows solar production to start earlier and continue later in the day. MPV also provided me a written report from the Nearmap Solar software showing the estimated average daily energy output by month for the proposed installation.As an Electrical Engineer, I had lots of technical questions which Matt was able to fully answer during the site visit and via several follow-up emails.While MPV were not the cheapest quote, I chose them because of this knowledge and the fact that they are a company that provides Commercial and Residential electrical services as well as solar system installations. This gave me a level of comfort that they would still be around in the future.The system included an LG Chem RESU 10H battery and changes to the house wiring to connect two lighting circuits, the kitchen power circuit and a powerpoint for the Internet cable modem, to the battery backup. This allows these circuits to continue to operate in the event of a blackout and can operate for extended periods without grid power if required.The installation of the solar panels and the inverter occurred on one (long) day. The MPV team arrived on time and were excellent, leaving the site clean and tidy. Three days later, MPV returned to make the changes to the house wiring, connect to the meterbox and make the data connections for the monitoring system. MPV also installed the Smartmeter (this was allowed in 2017, but not now I believe). The battery was installed 8-weeks later as it was a new model and Solaredge & LG-Chem were finalising the software configuration and testing. (MPV had given me the option of waiting and having a single installation, but I opted to get the solar panels installed ASAP.)I have experience in the System Control and Telecommunications industries and can say that I was very impressed with the quality of the workmanship by the MPV team during the installation process. I was also very happy that MPV granted me full access to the monitoring software provided as part of the Solaredge system, which gives great insight into the performance of the entire system.Since installation, the entire system has operated perfectly, producing on average, more than the Nearmap estimated daily output. There have also been several blackouts during this period and the battery back-up has operated correctly ensuring that the lights and more importantly, the fridge and freezer, continued to operate when there was no grid power.There was one issue in December 2018, where there was a brown-out on the grid (the monitoring showed 163VAC) and the Inverter & Battery couldnâ€™t appear to decide whether to remain connected to the grid or switch to battery backup. This resulted in a period of switching between the two states. I reported this to MPV who raised an Incident report with Solaredge which resulted in a firmware upgrade being installed on the Inverter the next day! This response confirmed my decision to go with MPV.I would definitely recommend MPV as a professional installation company who use top quality equipment and back this up with excellent ongoing support.

Peak Solar impressed us from start to finish. Thomas was brilliant and great to deal with. He explained each step in detail and was quick to answer any questions throughout the process. Justin and the team were so efficient and professional with the install. We are very pleased with the final result and looking forward to being (almost) power bill-free. Marque and Jenni.

Great company that not only provides excellent service but is very reasonably priced. The follow-up service is second to none and whilst I rarely write reviews this is a company I felt deserved the time. The best thing I can say is they listened and advised based on my needs, budget and long term goals to provide a system that is perfect for me now and into the future. Thanks guys you truly are why locals are best.
The staff at Peak Energy Group were exceptionally helpful, offering expert advice and guidance throughout the entire process. I highly recommend their services.

Contact made by Peak Energy Group from my enquiry on solarquotes website was prompt, site visit arranged and quote provided by Thomas done efficiently and thoroughly. All my queries were answered by Thomas or Justin in a timely and respectful manner.The installation was clean and tidy, everything as I expected it to be. They were on time in the morning and by the afternoon our new battery was grid connected and charging. We haven’t imported from the grid since!Installation has been inspected and approved.Overall an excellent customer experience. Very happy to recommend Peak Energy Group.

Everything went like clockwork. Cannot fault their service, the System works beautifully and the Backup appears to work in a milli second. Couldn't be happier at this early stage. Pumping out the power to house, battery and Grid.

The whole process from start to finish was professional and timely. They listened to my objectives, quoted and supplied a system to my exact needs. No question was left unanswered.  I couldn't be happier.

Michael and the team at MSA Electrical installed a 7.48 kW LONGi solar array, an Alpha-ESS SMILE 5 hybrid inverter, and a 13.3 kWh battery at our place in Point Cook. The whole job was seamless: the panels are perfectly aligned, the cabling is tidy, and we were generating our own power by that first afternoon—the battery easily covered the evening load.A few weeks later an Alpha-ESS recall cropped up. Michael dealt with the paperwork, chased the supplier, and organised the replacement before we even had time to worry. He was tougher on the manufacturer than I would have been.Bottom line? MSA treat your roof like their own, still answer the phone after the invoice is paid, and check in later to make sure everything’s humming. If that sounds good to you, give them a call.
These guys were great, prices were fantastic and quality was perfect.
Installation went well on 27/5/2022 & 1/6/22. Has been working well for last 3 years. SolarEdge 10kWh battery, Solar Edge optimisers, Hyundai panels.

The solar PV system and Tesla battery were installed by DQ Electrical, a contractor employed by Clipsal Solar. Don's team was excellent, and the installation was very neat.The system was excellent value as we qualified for the SA Government battery rebate of $6,000 and enrolled onto the Simply Energy VPP which we received $3,000 (both are no longer available)The monitoring platform is not as good as others; it does not send a warning if the system is not operating and does not integrate with the battery. I need the Tesla app to check the battery state. I have dual-pointed the monitoring device to Solar Analytics' website (since it is the same device), and I use Solar Analytics for technical support and queries. They respond in days, not weeks, and they know their stuff.Overall, it was a great installation with an average app, does not do what is states and poor and slow customer service.
10K difference on same materials.  Unfortunately found that out after committing to install solar & battery. Not worth the money at all.

Sales team are the only ones who will call you, everyone else you'll have to chase.  Clipsal 'Pulse' / 'Cortex' Monitoring system is always wrong, values never match what is actually happening.  you'll need to provide a separate Wifi / internet connection if you have a battery as the connection provided by Clipsal only monitors the inverter / grid connections.  No after-install support is forthcoming.  Installation provided by external contractors with no quality control procedures to ensure they've done things correctly.  When Problems occur in installation they rely on external inspectors to rectify rather than correct it themselves.  Products are shipped across the country and back instead of direct from warehouse / suppliers to install address.  Avoid at all costs.

This team provided the best easy to understand quotation and explanation.The follow up about each step that could I required for the Solar system to install was explained in detail.The installer  were very polite and easy to deal with, timing was good despite it was a rain in between.I've decided to go for the battery installation, that is not going to be easy due the issues with the supplier that also has been explained

From quotation to commissioning, Clipsal Solar’s advice, attention to detail and support have been simply outstanding. We had a 5KW system, to which we wanted to add a battery and additional panels. Why? We had watched as declining feed-in tariffs and rising buy rates for power led to some truely shocking power bills, and wanted our solar system to make large power bills a thing of the past. Jayden from Clipsal Solar understood what we wanted to do and gave us three very professional and easily-understood quotations for us to consider. We chose the one which was the most future-proofing one, and it was duly installed - no mean feat during times of regional lockdowns, business and travel restrictions and the like - but we were reassured by the communications throughout from Clipsal Solar’s technical and support people. Pulse, Clipsal’s analytic package was installed and has ensured that system health and performance has been monitored since commissioning.The result? Our existing 5KW system is fully integrated with the new 6.6KW system in the charging of our 13KWh LG Resu battery, and in the export of surplus power to the grid thanks to the Goodwe 5048D inverter. Our monthly power bills have always been in substantial credit since the new system was commissionedWe simply cannot fault the performance of Clipsal Solar at every step of the process and would recommend their services without reservation.

We went with Clipsal Solar with a competitive price, good sales prices with the consultant doing a number of quotes for different inverter and panel combinations and two system sizes. Also a consideration is  that it is likely that Clipsal Solar should still be around in a decade for any warranty claims. An onsite inspection was done by the installer ASI to confirm installation details including the inverter site. Installation was booked for two weeks after the deposit was paid. Australian Solar Installs Pty Ltd (ASI) was the installer. They were on time, friendly and tidy. The wiring to the switchboard and the inverter in the garage was all done in the wall cavities. Very neat finish at the inverter site.No visible conduit. I did go out and buy spare tiles during the installation as about 6 were broken. I did expect that. ASI happily swapped out some of the painted roof tiles ones under the panels with the unpainted spares so that the look of the roof was maintained. They did silicone a couple of tiles instead of replacing them so I'll replace them with two of the remaining spare painted tiles. The inspector can a few days later and he thought it was a very good installation and he rates ASI highly.Overall, the prices had been great and W look forward to the merger reconfiguration bring done soon so we can start getting FIT credit. Clipsal Solar are organising that.

review_description: Clipsal Solar wasn’t the most expensive nor the cheapest but I would highly recommend them.  They made the experience easy updating me all the way.  Always on time and all workmen were polite and helpful.  Did a great job on instal and I would not have know they were there cleaning up after themselves.  Product working well so far very happy.

- The sales and quoting was very good especially Anosh Vakeel.- Installation was smooth and the Technicians and Electrician were polite and efficient. Observed allthe Covid safety requirements. They took all the rubbish with them.- The grid connection was not needed as it was already connected.- So far happy with monitoring and support.- Will advise as we progress along.

I took up the Empowering Homes Grant offered by the NSW government. Without this I wouldn't have been able to go the solar yet alone battery route.My calculations show that I should be able to payback the system in a 6 year period, yet the loan is 8 years but also interest free and no fees.My system was purchased through Clipsal Solar and Installed through Elite Power Group.Dealing with Clipsal were good and pricing was fair and came under a lot of others that appeared to be putting a bit extra on their costs probably due to being a government program. Looking at trade pricing it appears Clipsal making a 15-20% margin on the trade price of all the goods, where as the other were making a 30-40% margin. this is probably due to buying power of the Clipsal Giant vs the local companies which is upsetting but how things work.The Quality of the goods were mid range and they offer 15 years warranty, and Clipsal are a big company so I trust they will uphold that warranty.The install went well, my only issues was the use of Ducting for the cable install around the inverter wasn't all so great but hey what can you do. and the use of silver mounting hardware with black framed panel. this was quite disappointing and I will be raising this with Clipsal as it detracts from the sleek and clean look of the Trina Honey Panels.I haven't had all to great weather yet or been through a summer but the output isn't as much as what I had hoped for, likely due to having to put panels on my northern roof due to future renovations on the house and this being shaded in the morning during winter. I hoping either the summer will produce better results and maybe even a trim of the large neighbors gumtree is in order.Being a Electrician and Electrical Engineer I was able to install a second system on my shed again with a good we inverter and 3.5kw worth of panel this that massively increasing my daily kwh production equaling my 6.66kw system on my house roof's daily production.This will help me pay back this system much quicker as i was able to get this system really cheap.

I used Clipsal Solar to upgrade my existing solar system.The sales person who visited my property was excellent (Very courteous and knew his subject very well. He explained me everything in details)The system I selected and the installation process was very good (The only issue was the waiting period for installation)Their charges were very reasonable for the equipment they used.The other excellent thing I noted of this company is their after sale service.I can highly recommend Clipsal Solar to anyone.

Building a new home we chose to have Solar, with Battery. We obtained several quotes. While visiting Clipsal to discuss lighting selections, the lady asked if we needed Solar.... We had no idea Clipsal had a Solar Department. An appointment was made with Karan, who was extremely helpful in quietly explaining to two novices in their 70's, how it all worked, and what savings we would get. Highly recommend Karan.Then a time was made for installation by Installers, DQ Electrical, first for a Pre Wire, then a final install. They adjusted to suit the Builder, and gave excellent service.Followup by Mirra at Clipsal on how to work with the Pulse App. She was so patient and helpful and it is lovely to know we have a "real" person to speak to once we move in.Overall, the Clipsal Solar experience went very smoothly, and would recommend the company. But I do believe that very few people are aware of Clipsal Solar in South Australia.... we have never seen any advertising at all.Dean and Yvonne Bendall
Excellent quote and service. Installation team great. Excellent customer service from Clipsal.Value for money will be determined over the next few years!!
Sales, installation and service have so far been very impressive. The system as designed is beyond my expectations. Thanks Clipsal for the design and installation.

Anosh, the salesman, provided lots of options and informative advice. Once we made the decision to go ahead with the purchase, Clipsal kept us informed throughout the whole process. The installation team were punctual, polite and professional, and cleaned up after themselves. Very happy with the system.

Great sales pitch and follow ups. After sales pre install follow ups too are good. Surprise! Installation is outsourced, but to a good vendor, who also happened to give a quote to you. A bit of operational confusion by the installers recce team but the install team finds a solution. So all is well at the end. Clipsal post sales n post install customer service team haven't forgotten you and very good at keeping you informed and at ease. Great work.

The sales person Anosh was very polite and honest when discussing options. He gave us all the information we asked for and was clear with his recommendation.The install was quick and the people were very tidy and explained everything they were doing.The service team have answered all my questions in a way I can understand and promptly. The feature of reviewing my electricity bill and making sure I am with the best provider for my needs is 5 star stuff.Have recommended Clipsal to all my friends and family, so glad we made the right choice.

After having several solar providers out, Clipsal Solar was the first to explain the solution in simple terms. They were able to take me through my energy usage and explain exactly what system we would need to become more energy independent. The quote I was provided was very thorough. Installation was seamless and not at all disruptive.The Clipsal Solar Pulse Analytics App is quite addictive. I can easily see where we are using power and I can monitor usage remotely from my mobile phone so I have now become that mum that rings her kids to turn some lights off!

Being a fussy customer I was determined to only go with solar again if I could ensure the install process matched the quality of products supplied.Clipsal Solar met every question I had with precise responses, which made me feel very comfortable about my choice to proceed forward with them. I was nervous only about the installers who would be doing the work, as I understood through many years of experience that a product is only as good as the install.The correspondence and discussions had with the installers administration was pleasant and comforting, another plus.The 4 young lads who turned up made me feel very comfortable almost instantly, and explained the process in detail.  The workmanship is picture worthy, and the attitude and pride these installers demonstrated is quite frankly rare to see these days.I could not recommend Clipsal Solar enough, and write this review without any hesitation, and have locked in a Tesla battery install with them.The install was only completed less than a week ago, so Iâ€™m yet to see years of great performance as yet, but somehow I donâ€™t feel a bit concerned.

1 Very professional & well communicated2 Hard working polite & friendly young workers. No mess after.3 Yes all arranged. Transfer from one Power Retailer to the other very poor service each one refering me to the other via Chat system. Bloody poor until I contacted Origin & spoke to a young lady Consultant who was very efficient & switched on & filled me in on the current situation.

Sales and quoting process was excellent. pre and post sales also excellent. Installation was done on time and the installation crew were fantastic. Clipsal organized the grid connection install and even contacted me afterwards to offer any further assistance. Could not have been happier.

System is booked to be installed so can’t comment on performance. But happy with the quotation process and information supplied by installer. Confident system is the one best suited to our needs. Will know more once system is installed and up and running.

review_description: The sales process was great, the installation was delayed because despite taking our money for a Powerwall 3, they had never installed one and they were not yet approved for Victoria. After a few months delay it was all good. The electricians were great and the installation went smoothly. But then the submission of the electrical works Request and post-installation form (DER) to Ausnet is still not complete EIGHT MONTHS LATER. So no feed in tariff and lots of emails from Ausnet threatening to cancel our contract (whatever that means). Numerous emails and phone called to 1Komma5 and still not resolved. I really want to like this company but my patience is wearing thin.
Everything was well explained. Happy with quality of the system. Too early to tell about after sales service yet.

Sales and quoting were easy, as long as you supply the pictures they ask for you will get a quote very quickly.We had 13.2kw of solar and two Powerwall 3s installed. The installation itself was great. As you can see from the pictures attached to this review the finished product was very clean and tidy.We are still waiting on the inspection so cannot review the performance of the system but everything thus far has been excellent.

The sales process was smooth and completeInstallation team arrived on time and worked tirelessly over two days to set up the system.Now awaiting the Inspector for finalisation which has been organised by 1Komma5.

True warranty horror story - Be afraid of these guysI purchased a 10k solar setup and tesla powerwall 2 7 to 8 years ago.Firstly they installed the solar 7 months later the battery.Big wait times.On install they damaged my roof tiles in 2 place cause water damage to the house.That cost me alot to fix.Nice !!The system worked well for about 2 years saving me a fortune before the battery packed it.They then removed it and I waited another 6 months for replacement.After this it worked well except that about once or twice a week (during summer) it would throw the earth leakage breaker causing all the power to go off.I was told you need to have an electrician look at it, not their problem.Which brings us to about a year ago when the battery stopped working altogether.After dealing with Solaray and now 1komma5, they don't even talk to you, you follow their lodge tickets online and eventually get shunted to a Phillipines call centre who can't help you.I was ignored time and time again.I contacted Tesla who say your installer needs to look at it.The installer call centre kept trying to make me run reboots and wifi setups for 6 months before I got Tesla to pressure them to sent a technician out.Even Tesla said we can see from our end that it's not working and they sent me screen shots of their data to send to the installer (who also has access to the same info already.)When the technician finally came out - he asked me why he was here. He was not even informed of the case progress and after several hours he said - everything is installed properly there's no issue,except your battery is not connecting.I'm like I've been telling you guys this for 1 year already.I said what happens next, he said we will put everything in the report to the installer.I have never heard from them again.They will not respond to emails or phone calls.These are the exact cowboys that will rip you off and not honour the warranty!Btw Tesla also will not honour the warranty - it needs to be done by your installer they say, even though their product is faulty/Stay away from both.PS - Solaray now 1komma5 was an installer recommended from this sites 3 quotes.I had tried to do all I could to pick the right ppl and right gear.Very disappointed - my last winter powerbill was $1250 even having 10k solar.I'm now faced with replacing the whole lot- lucky it has paid for itself 2 years ago.But now I should be enjoying 7 odd years of savings and I'm not!

I’ve had a Solaredge inverter and one of their batteries since 2022 it has worked perfectly since installation. Adding a second SolarEdge battery should have been straightforward I thought….Of three installers, 1komma5 were by far the most responsive and offered the best price. They were quick to arrange the install and evaluate the best position.It was a little disquieting to hear the first sub-contractor hadn’t done a SolarEdge battery install before and the left without saying goodbye or how the installation had gone. I looked at my SolarEdge and saw the 2 batteries and thought all was well. That night I paid the final payment.A couple of days passed and I realised that my Amber and SolarEdge apps wasn’t seeing any production. The next week a second subcontractor came out and spent a morning trying to make the system work.Another week and SolarEdge advised the inverter needed to be replaced which would be  done under warranty. This was done by a third subcontractor and after 6 hours the system which had worked perfectly before the second battery was added was still no closer to working. What was more SolarEdge advised it was after the fact reneging on replacing the inverter under warranty.By now I’d have settled for returning the system back to the original as the installer and Solaredge didn’t seem to have a solution to fixing and neither seemed to want to fix the problem.I opened a SolarEdge case on their portal expressing extreme frustration. This was about 4 weeks after having no working system and getting charged higher electricity charges from the Amber wholesale market . No battery and I wasn’t shielded from price spikes.Another week and my case did jolt SolarEdge into doing something. It seems they sent out the wrong replacement inverter and now would replace it with a third under warranty.I’m still waiting for this third inverter to be delivered to the installer whereafter they have promised to come out and install and I hope restore the system. But my confidence in this being the outcome isn’t great but I’m really hoping it can’t get any worse…And to add salt into the wound, SolarEdge sent me the $500 cashback card which can’t be activated because it looks like it’s from some dodgy gift card company which can’t be contacted. This was a material inducement to why I invested in a second of their batteries.Overall to date a terrible experience.

Easy process.The person who quoted and the one who followed up were able to answer all my questions and followed up well in the installation and operation.The installers were efficient but lacked some communication skills.The system installed meets every expectation.

I had obtained many quotes from different suppliers as well as different t configurations. Eventually settled on 30 panels, inverter and battery for my house on 3phase supply.Got a full electrical switchboard upgrade in the process as I still had old fuses and all circuits were not protected.The install was done days after agreeing to terms and a team of 4 came to do both the switchboard work and the roof work. The work was delayed by rain so didn’t quite finish up on the Friday afternoon but a couple of guys returned on Saturday morning to job. They were all polite and helpful. There was a small problem where one of the panel arrays looked to be not generating anything but this was rectified when the installer returned and found a connector not quite pushed home far enough to positively lock into place.I was shown the basics around the shutdown startup process along with the supplemental signage in and around the switchboard and inverter.I was given access to the monitoring app to observe system performance.I found by accident that the wrong inverter profile was loaded as it was causing he inverter to switch to standby in the middle of the day at times but once this was corrected, the problem has gone away.Pretty satisfied.

From start to finish, the process with 1KOMMA5 has been excellent – definitely a 10/10 experience.Graeme was outstanding throughout – always available, great with follow-ups, and super accommodating with calls on the fly.Brent and Daniel, the installers, went above and beyond – even removing an old satellite dish and taking it to be recycled. That kind of initiative really stood out.When our batteries didn’t kick in due to a tree over a powerline late on a Friday, I called at 5pm and was amazed at the support. Area Manager Tommy got me in touch with Brent again, and together we manually sorted the issue. I was genuinely impressed that they took the call after hours and stuck with it until it was resolved.To me, that shows 1KOMMA5 doesn’t just stop at installation – they’re in it for the long haul, with real support when you need it.Cheers,Jimmy

Oct 2024 - The Salesperson & ordering process was efficient and followed up with a good value for money quote which I accepted for 25 Trina Solar panels and Tesla Powerwall3 battery. The Panels installed within first12 days of signing with the panel installers very good, quick & courteous.. Very happy with efficiency to this point.Tesla Powerwall3 installation was more challenging with delays and a lack of communication. Eventually battery installed  early December and working.Mid January Tesla Powerwall3 fails and so starts a lengthy process of seeking warranty work to fixed the problem.March 2025 - I finally have a replacement Tesla Powerwall3 installed and system is again functioning after 5 weeks.1KOMMA5 customer service and communication really needs to be improved.

The Sales/Quoting process was straightforward and the Salesperson was attentive and responsive to my questions.I did raise concerns about their mixed reviews, but was assured they would take care of me and that I could expect a seamless & stressless experience……after all they are the major supplier and installer of Powerwall in Australia, or so I was told.The installation was a nightmare. It dragged on for weeks, with dates and times being changed constantly and with very poor communication from both the Sydney based supplier and Newcastle based installer. There was a decided disconnect between the parties.I will spare the reader the lengthy list of issues and frustration I had to contend with. It was a diabolical experience…Apart from that the system appears to be working well now

We used 1Komma5 from a solarquotes recommendation, to install a 12.8kwh Sungrow battery and upgrade the inverter to a 6kw hybrid Sungrow inverter to our existing solar system.1Komma5 were great to deal with, no hard sell, all questions answered, great customer service.Install guys were great! Professional install, neat and tidy. really good job.

1Komma5, paid a Deposit last October 2024 for a Tesla Powerwall 2 and it's now February 2025 and it still hasn't been installed. At this stage I think we have lost our money. I don't really mind as long as I can let other people know how bad they are to deal with hopefully they won't have the dramas Im having with them.

-sales person was very good, i have asked for more batteries installation in the next few months!!-the installers did a fantastic, neat job and all were very courteous, did not leave until the job was thoroughly tested and working.

Fantastic sales service with all my questions answered and adjustments made as required. The process went quiet for a couple of weeks until I was contacted with an installation date. Everything was smooth from there with the installation proceeding on time and everything working as expected.

1KOMMA5 were great to deal with and were able  to install in the shortest time frame of the suppliers we engaged. They also price matched the cheapest of the quotes we had. Jordan on their sales team was particularly helpful and followed up right through to installation to ensure the timeframes we had stipulated were met by their service team.

Overall, they did a great job. During the process I was contacted by a number of different people in the company, which I found confusing. At the end of the day they did a great job and we are very happy.
Great experience all round. Good price. Very good service and install was quick and guys super friendly.Very Happy overall

End to end service was impeccable. Salesperson was helpful, communicative and knowledgeable. Installers were efficient and also highly communicative. No complaints, and since installation have basically taken no power from the grid. Very happy customer!

Greg (sales) from 1KOMMA5 Melbourne gave us a detailed , comprehensive quote with no hidden extras . Josh (installer) did a site visit as part of the quote process.The installation was scheduled and we were kept well informed. The team were friendly, punctual, polite and cleaned up after themselves leaving a neat job.We were helped to set up and shown how to use the Tesla app. They have organised future inspection andother approvals.

Initial installation date quick for solar panels but battery installation cancelled 3 times at the last minute, 4th time lucky they turned up and installed the battery efficiently but couldn't connect to the panels they installed as the were wired wrongly!! Only connected to our original panels.Also the only place for ours to go was in the garage, so should have had a metal pole installed in front of the battery for safety. So no pole and no connection as yet, I emailed today to inquire when this would be done and have had no reply as yet. Really not happy with the service. Unsure of size I got but put 10kw!

I initially had a good experience with 1Komma5 during the sales process as they scoped and rescoped a Powerwall 2 battery but after accepting the quote, paying the deposit and then full amount, it all went bad for weeks due to disorganisation, poor customer service and even now (4 months later) there's still something wrong they haven't rectified.Firstly, they kept on delaying and delaying the install date despite taking 100% of the money. We had 3 changes including complete no shows on the day. I had called them and asking what was going on the supposed day of install - they assured me they would get back to me but never did til 5:30pm (via email). They had sent an SMS the day before (which had gone to my spam folder) but I expected more than an SMS. The person responsible for the install experience never replied to my calls or emails.After 2 delays, they promised to install an EV charger for free on the install date.On the (actual) install date (which was a Friday), the hardware install all went smoothly and well, including the EV charger install. However it wasn't all working as a software update and some other things needed to happen before it all could go online. The install team would have to come back at some point - once again no promises when this would oocur but they would "try" to come the following week. I was pretty unimpressed.Thankfully they did come on the Monday afterwards (unannounced) and got it working.After they left, I noticed my carport lights were no longer working and I contacted the team to ask what happened, to which a ticket was logged but I'm yet to receive any word or fix. I'm going to have to pay my own electrician to fix it.Stay well away from this crew.

Sales and quoting were great v they understood our needs and constraints and optimised for us.Install was straightforward.They organised everything, including the new smart meter that we need to sell energy to the grid.

Quote and price very professional.Installation not as professional:First of all we were asked to supply photographs of where the power box was a where we wanted out Powerwall installed. I supplied several photographs and explained where I wanted it and why. No one called me back to discuss our installation requirement.When the installers arrived they said they had not seen the pix, no had told them anything. They went on to tell us we would have to have the PW2 in a different location because the cabling to where we wanted it would be too long. Why ask for the pix if you’re not going to use them?
Knowledgeable sales person, easy and fast installation, good service. Only hiccup was the Tesla battery software needed updating which delayed the set-up by 5 days, which was a bit frustrating.

The sales process was responsive, informed and personal, easily the best we've experienced. Unfortunately, the critical issue of battery location was messed-up at pre-sale stage and led to difficult discussion with the install and support teams.  Pre-sale also failed to warn us regarding the known challenges of battery install when you are dealing with Box gutters, this led to more difficult discussions with install team.Overall, we are happy with the system performance and the client recovery undertaken to get us the best possibleoutcome. This could have been an all round 5 star review and a much smoother experience if pre sale was better equipped to accurately address known install issues and/or know when to refer to an installer for accurate information.

The sales/quoting process was confusing. They were reluctant to do a site visit. I then found out they do not complete the installation but use a contractor. The contractor was helpful, tidy and punctual.Customer service was very poor. A number of people from the company were in contact, but did not actually do much. There were no instructions on how to use or make the most of the battery. Three weeks later I still do not have the final paperwork and do not know what the situation is with my energy supplier. My battery is working but not to its optimum.Not impressed with 1KOMMA5.

Arrived on time .Went through all the procedures straight away explaining where everything will be installed i.e battery placement ,cables and panels.Job completed on time and everything all setup and running by end of day.Very satisfied and so far have not encountered any faults.

Everything started fine - they met my price request, agreed to install in 1 week's time, turned up on time, then, in one day, they removed 2 old systems and installed 30 new panels, inverter and a Sungrow modular battery.
